tests.name: Rig: Position mover_transwarp player at Sector 1

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id = 1 WHERE name = 'mover_transwarp';

tests.name: Rig: Position mover_transwarp ship at Sector 1

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id = 1, has_transwarp = TRUE WHERE ship_id = (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name = 'mover_transwarp');

tests.name: Rig: Ensure a direct one-sector transwarp distance

data.sql: INSERT INTO sector_warps (from_sector, to_sector) VALUES (1, 10) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

tests.name: Rig: Deploy the required homing fighter at the destination

data.sql: INSERT INTO sector_assets (sector_id, owner_id, corporation_id, asset_type, quantity, offensive_setting, deployed_at) SELECT 10, player_id, 0, 2, 1, 2, now() FROM players WHERE name = 'mover_transwarp'

tests.name: Rig: Set mover_transwarp Fuel Ore cargo to two

data.sql: INSERT INTO ship_cargo (ship_id, commodity_code, quantity) SELECT ship_id, 'ORE', 2 FROM players WHERE name = 'mover_transwarp' ON CONFLICT (ship_id, commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity = 2

tests.name: Rig: Synchronize legacy Fuel Ore column

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET ore = 2 WHERE ship_id = (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name = 'mover_transwarp')
SELECT t.turns_remaining, p.sector_id FROM turns t JOIN players p ON p.player_id=t.player_id WHERE p.name='mover_transwarp';

tests.name: Negative: Out-of-universe transwarp destination is refused
Invalid destination preserves turns and location

data.sql: SELECT t.turns_remaining, p.sector_id FROM turns t JOIN players p ON p.player_id=t.player_id WHERE p.name='mover_transwarp';

tests.name: Negative: Insufficient transwarp Fuel Ore is refused
Insufficient fuel preserves fuel turns and location

data.sql: SELECT t.turns_remaining, p.sector_id, c.quantity FROM turns t JOIN players p ON p.player_id=t.player_id JOIN ship_cargo c ON c.ship_id=p.ship_id AND c.commodity_code='ORE' WHERE p.name='mover_transwarp';

tests.name: Rig: Provide exactly three Fuel Ore for one-hop transwarp

data.sql: UPDATE ship_cargo SET quantity = 3 WHERE ship_id = (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='mover_transwarp') AND commodity_code='ORE'

tests.name: Rig: Synchronize legacy column before transwarp

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET ore = 3 WHERE ship_id = (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='mover_transwarp')

tests.name: Positive: One-hop transwarp consumes exactly three Fuel Ore
Successful transwarp persists fuel debit and destination

data.sql: SELECT p.sector_id, COALESCE(c.quantity, 0) FROM players p LEFT JOIN ship_cargo c ON c.ship_id=p.ship_id AND c.commodity_code='ORE' WHERE p.name='mover_transwarp';
